text:
Rae: Quick idea for the sidenav: collapse sections into "scopes" (e.g., Project scope, Model scope) so the top row is simpler. When a deep link lands we should open the matching scope automatically and reveal the leaf. Sketch: https://figma.redwood/sidenav-scopes.png :sparkles:
Jon: Sounds sensible. Main constraints: keep canonical URLs unchanged (e.g., /models/abc/versions/1). Client should not append hashes. On hydrate resolve path -> sidebar node -> expand ancestors -> mark visible.
Celine: Accessibility notes: the scope toggle must be a real button with aria-expanded and aria-controls. When it opens, add a polite live-region message like "Project scope opened, 4 items". Respect prefers-reduced-motion for any animation.
Pedro: For focus: autofocus the leaf only for hard loads/bookmarks. If users are navigating inside the app, don't steal focus. Also when we expand a scope via keyboard, move focus into the first child.
Rae: Breadcrumb rules: show just the humanized trail: Project Name > Models > MyModel > Versions > v2. Avoid repeating scope names. Use displayName where available, fallback to slug.
Jon: Edge-case: slug collisions across scopes (e.g., /projects/:id and /models/:id). Match by longest static prefix, then by the sidebar order as deterministic tie-breaker.
Celine: Microcopy: scope toggle label should be contextual: "Show Models" / "Hide Models" rather than generic "Expand" so screen readers get better context. Also add a "Skip to main content" link for external landings.
Pedro: Implementation note: on route change run `const node = findNodeForPath(path); if (!node) fallbackToRoot(); else expandAncestors(node); if (isHardLoad) node.element.focus();` Keep collapsed children out of tab order (tabindex=-1 & aria-hidden=true).
Rae: Visual indicator idea: instead of a badge, show a subtle right chevron fill on the scope header when active. Poll: react :thumbsup: for chevron-fill, :eyes: for small dot.
Jon: :thumbsup:
Celine: :eyes:
a11y-bot: Reminder: include unit tests for aria-expanded toggles, an integration test for deep link hydrate (collapsed -> expand + focus), and a screen-reader smoke test asserting live-region text.
Pedro: Also add server-side URL normalization for duplicate slashes/trailing slash (301) to prevent duplicate breadcrumb states. Client should also normalize navigations.
Rae: I'll draft the RFC with examples, pseudocode, ARIA checklist, and Figma frames. Tagging @Jon and @Celine for review.
Jon: Thanks — I'll stub the route->node matcher tests.
Celine: I'll add the SR copy and reduced-motion frames to Figma.
Rae: Will post the PR and Figma links here when they're ready. Thanks everyone!
